verdict.rationale: Kit's V4 API documents bulk subscriber creation with OAuth (kit-docs-23) and an async callback design for large batches (kit-docs-35/54). It also supports custom fields, including bulk creation and bulk updates of field values across many subscribers (kit-docs-38/39/73/74), with cursor pagination up to 1000 per page (kit-docs-34/53). Suppression is only evidenced as inbound webhook events (subscriber.unsubscribed/bounced), not as an API action to suppress or unsubscribe a contact. missing for 10: a documented API endpoint for suppressing or unsubscribing contacts, an explicit single-subscriber create/update endpoint reference, rate-limit/throughput documentation for production scale, independent or hands-on corroboration.
